historical_record.description: The Commission's schedule of dedications for six new or improved playgrounds of the 1947 recreation bond program set March 10 for J. P. Murphy Playground.
The Recreation Commission awarded the contract to build the field house at John P. Murphy Playground, 9th Avenue and Ortega Street, to Antone Petersen & Sons, the lowest of four bids.
